description: This file contains shell script functions for checking, copying configuration, and performing upgrades on a platform, specifically related to partition management, image handling, and device updates for Linux-based embedded or IoT devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of a given image against the current device to determine if it has changed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the device's partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the device upgrade process, including partition comparison, image writing, and UUID writing.
